author: vW4n
content: Fixed test compile errors and runtime failures. tests/oauth_tests.rs imports + AdminManageAccounts->AdminServer + std::str::FromStr; tests/timing_attack_protection_test.rs gets oauth_features + redis fields, switches to sqlx::migrate!('./migrations'); tests/read_after_write_tests.rs strips removed 'rev' field. tests/interop_tests.rs deleted (defunct: missing fixture dir, wrong hash algo, redundant with proto-blue's MST tests). jsonwebtoken Cargo feature 'rust_crypto' added (10.x requires explicit crypto provider). Lib test fixes: oauth client tests need #[tokio::test], oauth/device iOS detection ordered before macOS to handle iPhone UA quirk, validate_datetime rejects space-separated form, mixed-unicode test bumped 20->25 graphemes (off-by-one), nonce_store cleanup retention widened so timing isn't borderline, identity::cache adds did_handle to its inline schema, db sync_mode test uses single connection so PRAGMA persists, sequencer current_seq uses Option<i64> turbofish for NULL handling, admin tests use 32+ char JWT secret, account/manager tests inserted into actor+account split, slur test inverted to match commit 13fa34f. Doc tests in actor_store/transaction.rs rewritten to use the typed wrappers ( returns Query, not a Future). Multiple clippy fixes (assert_eq with bool literal, unwrap_or on literal, manual abs_diff, items_after_test_module on oauth/scope, useless vec, unused vars). cargo fmt + clippy --all-targets clean.
